latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Structured Reflection Protocol skill.

- Provides a step-by-step protocol for structured reflection after any learning experience, project, procedure, or performance.
- Includes prompts and guidance for capturing what went well, what could be improved, related experiences, and strategies for next time.
- Adapts language and format for different roles (e.g., student, professional, clinician).
- Handles both individual and team reflections; prompts for required context if missing.
- Offers both full and short-form outputs based on user needs and time constraints.
- Integrates with prior reflections when available for pattern recognition.
